instruction: Show me the Threshold dialog window.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Threshold color adjustment dialog. Evaluator checks for 'colors-threshold' in GIMP's action-history. Maintains similar simplicity and difficulty as the original Vignette task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can verify the instruction requirement
Getter correctly reads GIMP's action-history file to check if Threshold dialog was opened
Metric check_include_exclude correctly validates presence of 'colors-threshold' action and absence of error indicators
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP to flush action-history to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the only requirement (showing Threshold dialog)
Minor consideration: action-history accumulates all actions, so old entries from previous sessions could theoretically cause false positives, but this is acceptable in clean test environments
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding timestamp verification or clearing action-history in setup if false positives from previous sessions become an issue in practice
